summary: Cursor Settings → Features → enable Third-party skills. Merge adapters/cursor/settings.sample.json into .claude/settings.json (replace __INSTALL_DIR__). Do not also wire the same events in .cursor/hooks.json — double execution is possible. Third-party layer maps Claude hook names; relays still normalize conversation_id → session_id.
